jobs.title: Data Engineer (Snowflake / Finance Data Platform)
jobs.description: For our client in the financial services industry, we are looking for an experienced Data Engineer specializing in Snowflake, SQL, and Python. In this role, you will support the further development of a modern Finance Data Platform. The primary focus is on integrating financial data into Snowflake, enhancing existing Finance Data Marts, and building scalable, reliable data pipelines. Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines from various Finance applications and source systems into Snowflake Further develop existing Finance Data Marts and underlying data models Integrate new Finance data sources using modern ETL/ELT technologies and data integration patterns Ensure data quality, reliability, and availability across Finance data flows Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve data integration issues, implementing sustainable solutions Support automation, deployment processes, and modern engineering practices, including CI/CD and DevOps Collaborate closely with Finance teams, application developers, architects, and other technical stakeholders Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions Document data flows, data models, and implemented technical solutions Several years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering and Data Warehousing Strong expertise in Snowflake and SQL, particularly in designing and building scalable data pipelines Solid experience in data modelling, ideally including Data Vault Strong understanding of ETL/ELT processes and modern data integration architectures Practical experience with Python for data processing, integration, and automation Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and deployment automation is an advantage Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills Experience working with financial data, Accounting, or Controlling is an advantage Structured, independent, and solution-oriented working approach Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: At Uni Systems, we are working towards turning digital visions into reality. We are continuously growing and we are looking for a professional AI & NLP Engineer to join our UniQue Petten, Netherlands team. What will you be bringing to the team? Collect and clean data from various sources. Analyse datasets to identify trends and patterns. Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data needs. Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover insights. Recommend improvements based on data insights. Present data-driven insights and create actionable, decision-oriented recommendations tailored for non-technical audiences and stakeholders. Requirements What do you need to succeed in this position? Master Degree + minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience Knowledge and expertise on identification, collection, analysis, consolidation and modelling of data relevant to the materials demand and supply chain analysis for strategic technologies; Experience with data visualization and data mapping tools such as Tableau and ArcGIS; Ability to synthesize the result of large dataset analysis into communication and dissemination products such as reports, briefs and/or factsheets. Ability to analyse datasets, detect trends, and deliver evidence-based insights. Ability to resolve data issues and propose actionable improvements. Drive to explore new methods, tools, and data sources proactively. Flexibility to adopt new data platforms, tools, and approaches. Ability to understand, speak and write English. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform. We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe. Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain. jobs.title: Applied ML Engineer/Data Scientist
jobs.description: 🍇 About grape: Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first. At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you! Your role Our data and tech give us an edge in risk assessment, pricing and premium calculation. This role turns that into accurate models that support our carrier partners and our growth, builds tuned models where they beat rules and off-the-shelf LLMs in claims (triage, intervention, return-to-work, fraud), and responsibly explores how data can help employees stay healthy through grape Care. We’re looking for an applied ML engineer / data scientist to build predictive models from the ground up on real, regulated insurance data. You’ll own problems end to end, from effective-dated records to production, in a domain where correctness and responsible use genuinely matter. Starting points include pricing and risk, portfolio monitoring, claims and payment patterns, triage and return-to-work, absence, and fraud detection. grape sits on a rich dataset, though, and you’ll help find the next high-value use cases. You’re candid about what the data can support, and you propose simpler approaches when they’re the right answer. This is not an LLM role. LLM and agent workflows and document extraction sit with our engineering teams, and you’ll use their outputs as features
